children: RNS Number : 4725T  Hon Hai Precision Industry Co Ld  04 September 2026
Subject: To announce the corporate bond pricing on behalf of the Company's subsidiary, Foxconn Singapore Pte Ltd
3.Relationship to the Company (please enter "head office" or" subsidiaries"): subsidiary
The Company's subsidiary, Foxconn Singapore Pte Ltd, priced the corporate bonds ("Bonds") guaranteed by the Company in a total amount of JPY 101.9 billion under the Medium-Term Note programme.
The offering amount for tenor of 3 years with the fixed interest rate of 2.92%
is JPY 65.7 billion; for tenor of 5 years with the fixed interest rate of 3.28% is JPY 36.2 billion.
